name: Peer-to-peer rental index: NVIDIA B200 (per-GPU-hour, verified hosts)
price_basis: USD per GPU-HOUR for the GPU component, verified peer-to-peer hosts, 8-GPU bundles, observed 2026-10-03. Asking rate, NOT a realised rental.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-vast-rental-api. BAND: n=14 verified 8-GPU B200 hosts, range $6.2503-$9.3763/GPU-hr, median $7.9695; n=8 single-GPU hosts, range $6.2521-$9.3854, median $7.5104. Very tight 1-GPU vs 8-GPU medians ($7.51 vs $7.97) - the opposite of the H100 pattern, so the bundle-size effect is SKU-specific and should not be generalised. The 8-GPU band floor ($6.2503) is nearly identical to the 1-GPU floor ($6.2521), which is a strong hint that these offers are being priced off a per-card reference rather than off node economics.
